message: I run the repair café on Saturdays. Halfway through a busy morning someone always asks where their toaster went. I'd love the next volunteer to be able to pick up where I left off.

persona.goal: Identify and locate a visitor's item and let the next volunteer take over unfinished work.
priorities: Keep intake and lookup quick on a busy Saturday
Make shift handoff safe and usable
persona.preference: At shift change, show the last repair attempt and the next safe step.
persona.exclusion: We share one laptop. Please do not collect visitors' phone numbers.
